C0799.title: North Korea Uses Fake Interviews to Plant Malicious NPM Packages Targeting Cloud-Native Apps
C0799.summary: In July 2025, Socket disclosed a new npm poisoning wave in the Contagious Interview operation: North Korea-linked actors published 67 malicious packages with more than 17,000 total downloads. The report said the packages used XORIndex or HexEval loaders to retrieve BeaverTail and were linked to the InvisibleFerret backdoor.
